title: Establish Cybersecurity Responsibilities
description: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to the organization's cybersecurity program are established, communicated, enforced, and aligned within the organization and external partners.

title: Manage Cybersecurity Oversight
description: The organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policies are established.

title: Manage Incident Response Plans
description: Identify improvements by practicing cybersecurity and incident response plans to maintain and update the organization's cybersecurity program.

title: Supply Chain Incident Reporting & Vulnerability Disclosure
description: Organizations more rapidly learn about and respond to known incidents or breaches across vendors and service providers.

title: Manage Risks from Managed Service Providers
description: The risks posed by a managed service provider (MSP) are identified, recorded, assessed, prioritized, monitored, and updated over the course of the relationship.

title: Manage Organizational Assets
description: A maintained asset inventory to improve cybersecurity resilience by reducing downtime, aiding recovery, bolstering defenses, and improving preparedness.

title: Mitigate Known Vulnerabilities
description: Reduced likelihood of threat actors exploiting known vulnerabilities to breach organizational networks.

title: Obtain Independent Validation of Cybersecurity Controls
description: Validate that implemented security controls are properly configured and working as intended.

title: Maintain Vulnerability Disclosure/Reporting Process
description: Organizations more rapidly learn about vulnerabilities or weaknesses.

title: Document Network Topology
description: More efficiently and effectively respond to incidents and maintain service continuity.

title: Changing Default Passwords
description: Prevent threat actors from using default passwords to achieve initial access and move laterally in a network.

title: Establish Minimum Password Strength
description: Organizational passwords are harder for threat actors to guess or crack.

title: Create Unique Credentials
description: Adversaries are unable to reuse compromised credentials to move laterally across the organization, particularly between IT and OT networks.

title: Revoking Credentials for Departing Staff
description: Prevent unauthorized access to organizational accounts or resources by former staff.

title: Monitor Unsuccessful (Automated) Login Attempts
description: Protect organizations from automated, credential-based attacks.

title: Implement Multi-factor Authentication
description: Add a critical, additional layer of security to protect asset accounts.

title: Administrators Maintain Separate User and Privileged Accounts
description: Make it harder for threat actors to gain access to administrator or privileged accounts, even if common user accounts are compromised.

title: Implement the Principles of Least Privilege
description: Minimizes unauthorized access to systems, data, and processes, reduces human error, and prevents malicious actions.

title: Implement Logical/Physical Network Segmentation
description: Limiting the impact of a potential breach and preventing adversaries from accessing sensitive data, spaces, and/or critical infrastructure.

title: Implement Cybersecurity Training
description: Organizational users learn and perform more secure behaviors.

title: Utilize Strong Encryption
description: Encryption is deployed to maintain confidentiality and integrity of sensitive data across the organization's network.

title: Enable Email Security
description: Reduce risk from common email-based threats, such as spoofing, phishing, and interception.

title: Disable Autorun & Macros By Default
description: Reduce the risk from embedded macros and similar executable code.

title: Establish Change Management Processes
description: Policies and procedures exist to manage system changes and configurations.

title: Maintain System Backups & Restoration Ability
description: Organizations reduce data loss and service disruption risks while efficiently managing, responding to, and recovering from incidents.

title: Maintain Hardware & Software Approval Process
description: Increase visibility into deployed technology assets and reduce the likelihood of breach by users installing unapproved hardware, firmware, or software.

title: Maintain Log Collection & Storage
description: Enhance visibility to detect and respond to cyber incidents while ensuring security logs are protected from unauthorized access and tampering.

title: Prohibit Connection of Unauthorized Devices
description: Prevent malicious actors from achieving initial access or data exfiltration via unauthorized portable media devices.

title: Secure Internet Facing Devices
description: Unauthorized users cannot gain an initial system foothold by exploiting known weaknesses in internet-facing assets.

title: Establish Malicious Code Detection
description: Enables early threat identification, strengthens system integrity, provides insights for faster remediation, and minimizes downtime.

title: Identify Adverse Events
description: Organizations can identify adverse security events.

title: Establish Incident Communication Procedures
description: Coordinate crisis communication methods between internal and external organization partners and critical suppliers.

title: Establish Incident Reporting Procedures
description: CISA and other organizations are better able to provide assistance or understand the broader scope of a cyber incident.

title: Incident Planning and Preparedness
description: Organizations are capable of safely and effectively recovering from a cybersecurity incident.
